@@U03035@@
(Astonished.)

@@U03036@@
Remarkable! (The phial slips out of WAGNERS hands, hovers over 浮士德, and sheds light down upon him.) The beauty of the place! Clear streams in a dense grove. Women, undressing. Delightful! But it gets better all the time. There’s one, I see, the loveliest of them all, a splendid creature, born of a race of heroes, no, of the gods. She slips her foot into the transparent waters; her lovely body’s life flame cools in the shimmering crystal of the water. But what is that rush of wings, that roar and plunge that startles the placid waters? The women scatter in fright, and only she, the queen, looks on calmly with a woman's confident pride. She beholds with pleasure as the prince of swans, importunately yet gently, presses against her knees. You would almost think he’s at home there. Suddenly a mist arises, and with its closely woven veil conceals that loveliest of scenes.

@@U03038@@
What a tale, I must say! You may be small, but your fantasy certainly isn’t. I see nothing—
translation:
@@U03035@@
（惊讶。）

@@U03036@@
了不起！ （小瓶从瓦格纳斯手中滑落，悬停在浮士德上方，光照在他身上。）这个地方真美！茂密的树林中清澈的溪流。女人，脱衣服。愉快！但它一直在变得更好。我发现，其中有一个是最可爱的，一个辉煌的生物，诞生于英雄种族，不，是众神。她把脚滑进透明的海水里；她可爱的身体的生命火焰在闪闪发光的水晶水中冷却。但是，那惊动平静水面的翅膀的猛冲、轰鸣和猛冲到底是什么？女人们吓得四散奔逃，只有她这个女王，平静地看着，带着女人的自信骄傲。她高兴地看到天鹅王子固执而温柔地压在她的膝盖上。你几乎会认为他在那里自在。突然，一片薄雾升起，用它密密麻麻的面纱掩盖了那最美丽的景色。

@@U03038@@
我必须说，这真是一个故事！你可能很渺小，但你的幻想却很渺小。我什么也没看见——
